BIO PackathonGuidelines
Any individual or entity is eligible to participate in the hackathon either individually or in a team to showcase solutions aligned with the objectives of the hackathon, including the following:
Faculties, students and research scholars of academic institutions
Start-ups
Research institutions and laboratories
Industry
NGOs, societies and trusts
Note:Teams are encouraged to be multidisciplinary, combining expertise in materials science, packaging engineering, environmental science, and product design.
Applicants can register through the registration portal and submit the solution as per Solution Submission Template.
Solutions will be assessed based on:
Compliance with plastic-free requirement
Biodegradability performance
Packaging functionality and product safety
Innovation and originality
Scalability, affordability, and industry adoption potential
Evidences submitted
Based on the evaluation and recommendation by Screening Panels, participants will be shortlisted to make a presentation for final round assessment, either via video conferencing or in person (with prior intimation only), to the Assessment Board. The winning solutions of the hackathon will be recognized and awarded attractive prizes.
Certificate of participation shall be awarded to all participants shortlisted for making a presentation before the Assessment Board. Three participants selected by the Assessment Board after final round assessment shall be rewarded as follows:
1st Prize
Rs 10,00,000/-
2nd Prize
Rs 7,00,000/-
3rd Prize
Rs 5,00,000/-
Selected winning solutions may be considered for further support, including technical guidance, incubation assistance, and opportunities for pilot trials in collaboration with industry.
